evals.name: delegation-and-strategic-discipline
evals.prompt: Set up design context for the project at {FIXTURE_DIR} (treat that directory as the project root) so AI coding agents stay on brand. It's a cabin-booking site called Fernwood.
evals.expected_output: The flow scans the fixture, runs (or lists) the strategic interview instead of fabricating answers, and sources the DESIGN.md spec from ai-design-dot-md — using it if available or offering the npx install / GitHub one-off choice — never inventing the spec format from memory. No PRODUCT.md is created.
evals.baseline_failure: Baseline typically writes a freeform DESIGN.md (or style guide) immediately from the CSS with invented brand personality, never asks the user anything, and never references ai-design-dot-md.
expectations: Output references the ai-design-dot-md skill by name as the source of the DESIGN.md spec (using it, or offering to install/fetch it)
If ai-design-dot-md is treated as unavailable, the output offers the install command 'npx skills add robcsaszar/scaffold --skill ai-design-dot-md' and/or a GitHub one-off fetch as user choices
Output asks strategic interview questions (register, users/purpose, brand personality, or anti-references) rather than fabricating those answers as facts
No PRODUCT.md file is created or proposed as the deliverable
Strategic content is placed (or planned) as subsections inside the Overview section of DESIGN.md, not as new top-level sections
